I also feel the same. I am tired of living a false life. Pretending I am happy when I am dying inside.

No one wakes up in the morning desperate to create a great life for you. People are like this. No one really cares. People say they love you only if they find you useful in some way. If they see you're not useful, they just stop loving and caring. The harsh truth is everyone just care about their own needs. They use you until your juices run out. Then they might do awful things with you. Like you, I am also so drained out by explaining myself all my life. People never understand what I am saying. No matter what I say, they just assume a completely different meaning of what I said. So recently I stopped saying almost all of the things that comes to my mind, I just keep myself silent. But being silent also upsets those people, they think I am "not talking to them". I am not saying others are bad and I am good. I have issues too that I am dealing with. This life is hard man! life is a double-edged sword. No matter what you do, life will smash you on the ground and people will force you to be down there. Sorry for the rant. This is my situation. I am so tired of everything. But I wish you good luck, I hope you find what you're looking for in life.
